Chatter is a real–time messaging app developed by Mustafa Muhammad, aka H2SO4–1191…
Built with passion and dedication, it was developed entirely in Android Studio using Kotlin and XML, featuring both a robust frontend and backend…
Powered by a server that's online 24/7, Chatter mimics the functionalities of popular chat platforms while introducing a unique feature—a built–in generative AI for interactive conversations…
While it may not rival the largest apps, it still stands as a testament to the hard work and the hours spent in its development. I hope you appreciate this creation as much as I do in bringing it to life…

And I would like to note that your log-in password is completely secured and safe that even I can\'t access your account, but to keep in mind, the messages and chat records do get saved in a database but they won\'t be accessed if not necessary for developing goals…\nUnfortunately the database for Chatter is currently limited for it being just a test and hobby app so it is not clear what would happen to it in the future, meaning if you have really important information or chats it is not advised to rely on it…\n

In the mean time the app had been tested several times for bug hunts and currently it is quite clean, but if you encounter any please do contact me (Check contacting information down below) and describe the issue so I can work on it as soon as possible for a better user experience…
In this the very moment as I'm writing this paragraph for you, I cannot describe the joy and pride that I am feeling for overcoming all of the challenges that I had faced during the development phase, I guess it is the joy of creation and creativity…
And in the end of my message, I would like to give special thanks from me, H2SO4–1191 to you, my dear users…
